origin.description: Edition 2 pastes the clipboard into one string.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Edition 2 pastes the clipboard into one string.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
Sys.setenv(CLIPR_ALLOW = "TRUE")
x <- clipboard()
gsub("\n", "|", paste(as.character(x), collapse = "|"), fixed = TRUE)
